# From boot to the moment the first level's HUD comes up - where a recorded session (tools
ecord_play.ps1,
# runs
ecorded_pad.txt) starts; to_level.ps1 -Recorded plays this and then the recording.
# (the last step presses A only: START there could open the pause menu under the recording)
pressuntil START (00000000, 00000000)
wait 1500
pressuntil START (00000000, 00000000)
wait 1500
pressuntil A MainMenuIntroActivated
wait 5000
press A 200
wait 2500
press A 200
wait 2500
press A 200
pressuntil A OnCharacterSelection
wait 2000
press A 200
# (the opening cut-scenes: START skips one where it can)
pressuntil START/A IntroComplete
wait 4000
press A 200
wait 3000
pressuntil A ShowHudComplete
